scope: bounded patch behavioral model; no hosted CI, no production writes

details.back_race: On q2-q7 the current head allows Back while answerLock/eggResponding is active; the captured answer timer then advances from the old index, producing index=2 with visualQuestionIndex=0 in the deterministic reproduction. The bounded patch hides the control and fails closed in the handler, preserving index/visual continuity.
details.q8: The existing shouldEnterQ8Hatching/effect contract correctly waits for both response gesture completion and hatchReady; fast API, slow API and reduced-motion ordering were modeled separately.
details.replay: A valid counterexample exists where replay answers resolve to a different presentation bird than the saved profile. The patch uses birdPresentation(saved role/userId), matching Home.
details.palette: The patch uses the canonical state.player.palette through QuizEgg reveal and Home, so the same equipped palette is preserved across hatch -> reveal -> Home -> reload, assuming localState returns the persisted player palette as the current contract specifies.

limitations: This is not a full Mini App dependency/build/browser PASS.
The hosted container still has no outbound DNS and no exact checkout with node_modules/pnpm store; no assets were replaced with placeholders.
No CircleCI or GitHub Actions run was started.
